heading: Thursday, February 5, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 and OpenAI GPT-5.3-Codex.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.6
items.summary: Claude Opus 4.6 is the first Opus-class model with a 1M-token context window (beta) and 128K output tokens, and it adds adaptive thinking and agent teams in Claude Code. Anthropic reports the top score on Terminal-Bench 2.0 among the models it compared, at $5/$25 per million tokens.

image.alt: Video thumbnail from the Claude Opus 4.6 announcement

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3-Codex
items.summary: GPT-5.3-Codex combines GPT-5.2-Codex's coding ability with GPT-5.2's reasoning; OpenAI called it its most capable agentic coding model and said it runs about 25% faster. It launched across Codex surfaces for paid ChatGPT plans, with API access on February 24.
